title: Fix Engagement Option Text Sizing
description: Engagement options inside a window use ButtonGroupItem without the text prop, so labels don't get proper padding/typography and get clipped in the fixed h-medium button group. Pass text/icon correctly so option labels fit their text size.
summary: Engagement window options rendered labels as ButtonGroupItem children, inheriting square aspect-square sizing inside the fixed h-medium button group and clipping longer transition labels. Options now pass icon and text props so labels use proper padding, text-xs, and aspect-auto width.
